title: Initiative and Work Graph
intent: Separate a Work from a branch: the Work becomes its own ref, a branch exists only while there is code, and the Pull Request projection goes away.
motivation: The manifest could only live on a branch, so a backlog Work owned one it had no use for and deleting that branch deleted the Work from every listing. Alongside it sat a Pull Request projection no lifecycle transition read.
ordering: Delivered outside the backlog in 09ccf3c (v1.0.0), because every Work here rewrote the mechanism that would have tracked it. Recorded now with no Works: it never had tracked ones, and inventing them would be fabrication.
